query: For level one passenger flow control, it is triggered when the platform, concourse, and entrances/exits are quite crowded, with the number of people reaching 80% of the load and showing a continuous upward trend, expected to last over 30 minutes, seriously affecting station operations. The duty officer (operations) uses SC to remotely close two entry gates (AGM04, AGM05) and two automatic ticket machines (TVM01, ITVM01) to slow down ticket sales and limit entry flow. Set up barriers in front of security checkpoints for batching passengers to alleviate pressure on the paid area and downbound platform. Strengthen maintenance of order in concourse and platform, assign the duty officer (passenger service) to change the direction of downbound escalators, close upbound escalators, close No. 2 entrance escalators to speed up exit flow and slow down arrival to downbound platform, avoiding crowding, stampedes, or passenger disturbances. The station master decides to activate level one passenger flow control.
